issue.title: [YSQL] Flaky test PgLibPqTest.TablegroupCreationFailureWithRestart

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-5487](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5487)
### Description

The test PgLibPqTest.TablegroupCreationFailureWithRestart started to [fail](https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?analyze_trends=true&class=PgLibPqTest&name=TablegroupCreationFailureWithRestart) more often after 
https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commits/47d4d9797918bcf354d19da179ff7b3ec0ca7463

But it failed before that too, just not so often. 
Sometimes it fails with

body:
In log: https://jenkins.dev.yugabyte.com/job/github-yugabyte-db-alma8-master-clang15-release-aarch64/498/artifact/build/release-clang15-full-lto-ninja/yb-test-logs/tests-pgwrapper__pg_libpq-test/PgLibPqTest_TablegroupCreationFailureWithRestart.log
```
[m-1] W0210 04:24:57.887200 232686 ysql_transaction_ddl.cc:179] Shutting down. Cannot get GetTransactionStatus: { transaction_id: 6e2a2e51-6ae2-4cf0-a266-fe076e7b47b6 isolation: SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION status_tablet: {transactions_tablet_id2} priority: 17357822157958938753 start_time: { physical: 1676003088526750 } locality: GLOBAL old_status_tablet:  external_transaction: 0}
```
When restarting a cluster, the selected master leader fails to get transaction status hence failed CREATE TABELGROUP DDL doesn't get cleaned up.
@yifanguan to confirm, does this highlight an actual product issue, around create tablegroup + master restart?

@bmatican This is not a tablegroup specific issue but does look like an actual product issue which can happen if we restart a node. I started one slack thread for this issue: https://yugabyte.slack.com/archives/C03ULJYE0KG/p1677192114545119.
